title: Taiwanese Student Association at Arizona State University
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association at Arizona State University (TSA @ ASU) is a student organization based in Tempe, Arizona, that serves Taiwanese students at ASU. Its official Facebook page identifies it as the official presence of the Taiwanese Student Association at ASU (亞利桑那州立大學台灣同學會), and the organization maintains an active Instagram account under the handle @asu.tsa. A legacy university-hosted website at asu.edu/studentprgms/orgs/taiwan documented early activity including new student orientations and Lunar New Year celebrations, though that site has not been substantially updated in recent years.

The organization’s documented purpose centers on assisting Taiwanese students at ASU — helping new arrivals settle in, organizing social events and activities, and building community among Taiwanese students on campus. A former campus directory listing described it as “a club to assist students from Taiwan by helping new students to settle down, creating events and activities and forming stronger connections among Taiwanese students.” The org also maintains a Facebook group (facebook.com/groups/TSA.ArizonaStateUniversity) in addition to its official page.
